stem_book: A car is travelling on a banked road with a speed of 10 m/s on a banked road of inclination 37° in a circle of radius 30 m. The car does not skid. The correct free body diagram of car is: (a) [figure: N ⊥ incline, f down the incline] (b) [figure: N ⊥ incline, f up the incline] (c) [figure: N vertical, f up the incline] (d) [figure: N ⊥ incline, f up the incline and an extra horizontal f]
key: b (b) — N ⊥ incline and friction UP the slope (v = 10 m/s < v 0 = 15 m/s)
correct_answer: b N ⊥ incline, friction up the slope
work: v₀ = √(Rg tan37°) = √(30·10·0.75) = 15 m/s > 10 m/s → tends to slide down → friction up the slope
